description: This Java class defines an exception named PolicyEntryInvalidException used in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.policies package. It signifies that a policy entry is invalid and provides builder methods for creating instances, along with JSON serialization/deserialization support.

classes.name: PolicyEntryInvalidException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating invalid policy entries, extending DittoRuntimeException and implementing PolicyException. It includes static methods for creation from messages or JSON, and supports JSON schema versions.

classes.name: PolicyEntryInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: Builder class providing a fluent API for constructing instances of PolicyEntryInvalidException with specified headers, message, description, cause, and href.

methods.name: PolicyEntryInvalidException.newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder instance to construct PolicyEntryInvalidException objects.

methods.name: PolicyEntryInvalidException.fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a PolicyEntryInvalidException with a specified message and headers.

methods.name: PolicyEntryInvalidException.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a PolicyEntryInvalidException from a JSON object and headers, parsing error details from JSON.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns supported JSON schema versions for this exception, in this case, only version 2.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new exception instance with provided headers, copying other properties from the current instance.
